decisions.issues: v09 is acceptable, with notes. The brand is right: a pale, puckered patch of raised ridges on the inner LEFT forearm, which is turned across his body toward camera just above the bandaged wrist. It has no legible letters, no numerals and no cross. Nagoji matches his sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin with only a faint jaw shadow, gold ear drop, wet torn ochre tunic over red rope welts with no blood, and no irons. The Fisherman, in red lungi and shoulder cloth, gestures and talks beside the Woman. The Young Fisherman (indigo, headband) takes the legs. The Woman has a grey-streaked low knot, undyed cotton over both shoulders, no blouse and no gold. She works a cloth in her hands and looks down at the arm. There is no painted text and no balloons, and the hands are sound. Notes: (1) The weather does not match the page. The sky is grey and overcast and the surf behind is rough, while 5.1 to 5.3 are bright and sunny under a blue sky. The location matches (laterite house, thatch, village edge, wet ground like the wet path in 5.2), so this is a lighting shift, not a wrong setting. A warmer colour grade would reduce it. (2) Her expression is a slight downturned look with dark reddish lips rather than a clear betel half-smile. (3) She stands in front of the doorway rather than mid-step out of it. Lettering: both WOMAN balloons fit in the open grey sky at top left, above and left of the Fisherman's head, or in the dark doorway and laterite wall at upper right above the Young Fisherman's headband, with tails to her mouth. v02 is rejected as backup. Its brand is a crisp, scrolled, tattoo-like monogram that reads as letters (roughly 'NR' or 'AR') even at full-frame size. That is pseudo-text, and it breaks the bible's 'blurred past reading, no legible letters'. Its sunny sky would otherwise match the neighbouring panels better.

v09 is acceptable, and it is the better pick. Its 3:1 frame fills the full-width tier. The r4 five-lens review flagged v07 (3:2) as major because it printed as a narrow centred box, against the script's 'Full-width tier, not a narrow strip'. In v09 Nagoji matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, gold ear stud, long loose curly hair. He is bare-chested in the cream dhoti with rope burns, eyes closed and face lit by the hearth at left. Wrist bandages with some bare fingers and a red waist cord match the captivity sheet and 6.3. Behind him the Fisherman (red lungi, shoulder cloth) and the Young Fisherman (indigo, headband) turn toward the door. A broad turbaned shadow crosses the swept floor, and no figure appears in the doorway. The rain, palms and fence outside match 6.2 and 6.3, and the art has no text. The plain dark upper wall between Nagoji's head and the Fisherman (about x 0.34-0.60, y 0.02-0.15) holds caption 0 at upper left. The empty shadowed floor at lower right (about x 0.62-0.96, y 0.78-0.97) holds caption 1, which fixes the backwards stagger flagged in r4. Minor issues: the brand is a reddish puckered patch on the visible, more outer face of his LEFT forearm, not the pale inner-side mark the bible describes; it is tiny at print size and has no letters or blood. There is a small extra scar near his left elbow. The background figures are only slightly soft, not strongly out of focus. The Fisherman's beard is darker than his grizzled look elsewhere. Backup v07 is also clean for art and continuity, but its 3:2 shape recreates the narrow-panel layout problem.
